name: zaz⚡️os
long_description:
Software is now cheap to build. Every company will have its own custom all-in-one OS. zaz⚡️os is how they build it, without rebuilding everything from scratch.

zaz⚡️os is a customizable all-in-one OS for running a company. Instead of stitching together point solutions, each company gets its own single-tenant workspace with 26+ ready apps (performance, feedback, hiring, time off, payments) and an AI Studio to adapt any of them, or build new ones, to how the company actually works.
one_liner: The custom all-in-one OS for each company.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CEO of Zazos (YC S21). Murilo is a software engineer and was the Head of HR at Quero Education (YC S16), joining when it had 150 employees and scaling it to 700+. He also built Rio, an HR app that 70% of Quero’s employees used on a weekly basis.
